items.source: Uses of SqlMergeMode.MergeMode in org.springframework.test.context.jdbc
Enumeration of modes that dictate whether method-level @Sql declarations are merged with class-level @Sql declarations.
items.translation: 枚举模式，用于规定是否将方法级别的@Sql声明与类级别的@Sql声明合并。

items.source: JDBC support classes for the Spring TestContext Framework, including support for declarative SQL script execution via @Sql.
items.translation: Spring TestContext Framework 的 JDBC 支持类，包括通过 @Sql 声明式执行 SQL 脚本的支持。

items.source: Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name.
items.translation: 返回此类的具有指定名称的枚举常量。

items.source:
Returns an array containing the constants of this enum class, in
the order they are declared.
items.translation: 返回一个包含此枚举类常量的数组，按声明顺序排列。
